# Mahavir Sarees, Rewari

> Mahavir Sarees is a saree and lehenga shop at Mahavir Chowk, Bajaja Bazaar, in front of Hanuman Mandir, Rewari, Haryana 123401, India, serving customers since 2011. It sells silk sarees (Banarasi, Kanjivaram, Pashmina), bridal and designer sarees, designer lehengas, suits and girlish laccha. Wholesale rates for retailers, boutiques and bulk buyers; single pieces for every customer. Mahavir Sarees is the in-house brand of Mahavir Trading Company. Not related to other businesses named "Mahavir" in other cities.

Contact: call or WhatsApp +91 99207 53269 (also +91 93548 27020). Hours: Monday to Saturday 9:30 AM to 8:00 PM, Sunday 10:30 AM to 6:00 PM. Free shipping across India; cash on delivery with ₹250 advance; 7-day exchange with tag attached.

## Sarees
- [Rivaz](https://themahavirsarees.com/rivaz/): Weightless Silk Saree, mustard yellow and red print
- [Silsila](https://themahavirsarees.com/silsila/): Weightless Silk Saree, patola-style design
- [Mastani](https://themahavirsarees.com/mastani/): Silk Jerken Saree, gold zari butti and woven border
- [Dulhan](https://themahavirsarees.com/dulhan/): HO Pure Silk Saree, ethnic zari bridal design
